audio_identity: SHA-256 of original WAV file bytes; sha256 column in the committed manifest
summary_policy: Aggregates and checks retained; reproduce full per-recording calibration evidence with release_check.py --split calib.

displayed_formants.scoring: Labelled Fk versus the same Praat Fk; no pole reassignment. Errors require both slots present; missingness retains all eligible frames.

matched_filter_control.scoring: Labelled Fk versus the same Praat Fk; no pole reassignment. Errors require both slots present; missingness retains all eligible frames.
matched_filter_control.reference_policy: Praat Burg candidates filtered at bandwidth <= 400 Hz before alignment, then sorted/compacted exactly as the shipped selection rule. This controls selection-policy mismatch; it is not ground-truth accuracy.

changes: DC removal before resampling and before windowing
candidate_decision.evaluation_policy: Freeze this candidate after calibration; score the committed evaluation subset once.
